commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='d7c792ff0a591011fa64c86e2f37bb85a111687f'; TAG='checkpoint-phase3-golden-2026-09-08'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --no-tags origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG" >/tmp/checkpoint-tag.remote 2>/dev/null; then git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG:refs/tags/$TAG"; test "$(git rev-list -n1 "$TAG")" = "$EXPECTED"; else git tag -a "$TAG" "$EXPECTED" -m 'Phase 3 golden checkpoint: Quality #59 PASS; Secret Scan #89 PASS; Tester Release #16 PASS'; git push origin "refs/tags/$TAG"; fi; PEELED="$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG^{}" | awk '{print $1}')"; test "$PEELED" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'checkpoint_tag=%s\ncheckpoint_sha=%s\n' "$TAG" "$EXPECTED"
commands.output:
From https://github.com/MichalMatu/tracker
 * branch            main       -> FETCH_HEAD
To https://github.com/MichalMatu/tracker.git
 * [new tag]         checkpoint-phase3-golden-2026-09-08 -> checkpoint-phase3-golden-2026-09-08
checkpoint_tag=checkpoint-phase3-golden-2026-09-08
